She finds out, with the help of the owner of her publications, Jindal that Vishal was compelled to take the law in his own hands when the courts failed to punish the assailants of his sister and sweetheart. Soon, Vishal is released from prison, and begins to work for Jindal. It is then that he realizes that he has just walked from a walled prison, to an open prison, as the truth behind his release slowly but surely starts to dawn on him.

metas.name: Artificial

Santa has to rediscover his faith in goodness and call in some last-minute reinforcements from the one person no baddie wants to tangle with: Mrs. Claus.

When supernatural forces drag his daughter into an unknown world, he risks everything, venturing into terrifying dimensions where fear, mystery, and impossible truths stand between him and the only person he cannot afford to lose.

metas.description: A heartfelt tale of rediscovery about life and an unexpected second chance at love.

metas.name: Akka
metas.description: In a kingdom ruled by women, matriarch Bhavani faces her biggest threat in Rudra, a ruthless rebel eyeing her land and legacy.

metas.name: Hostel Haadsa
metas.description: A fearless skeptic unravels a haunted hostel's legend, only to become its next target.

metas.name: Chaar Yaar
metas.description: A story of four middle-class boys, their dreams, setbacks and friendship being their armour. A fateful decision leads them to take a step that changes the course of their lives trapping them between gangsters and cops. What once held them together slowly tears their bond. With their armour shattered, their enemies close in and fate serves up a bill for their crimes.

metas.name: Haju Vaat Chaale Che
metas.description: The story follows Shivani Dave, an independent private bank employee from a middle-class family in Vadodara. As she navigates the chaotic arranged marriage market, she meets seven prospective grooms (mirroring the seven steps of the Saptapadi), while her family deals with her father Vasantlal's secret struggle to save their ancestral home from a builder.

metas.name: Duniya Ki Thain Thain
metas.description: In Shaktipur, aspiring shooter Vikas's passionate romance with politician's daughter Vaishnavi spirals into crime and betrayal. Five years later, their worlds collide as gangster and IPS officer.

metas.name: Varam
metas.description: A poor slum dweller's life takes a massive, unexpected turn when he receives a mysterious boon (varam) that alters his fate, fortune, and future.

metas.name: Matargashti
metas.description: Dhara's plan to explore her sexuality puts her at odds with her horrified father, who becomes determined to sabotage her love life.

metas.name: Nine to Five
metas.description: A lifelong runner-up joins a cutthroat fin-tech startup where only one new hire makes the founder's elite unit. Can he finally be Number One?

metas.name: Kon Yashwant Pansare?
metas.description: Kon Yashwant Pansare? is a journey of a defeated lawyer. Yashwant Pansare is a lawyer who once worshipped the law. He went to all extents to fight for justice for the poor and underprivileged, and had complete faith in the judicial system.

metas.name: Bigg Boss
metas.description: Your ‘Host and Dost’ Salman Khan is back! Brace for another high-octane season of the greatest reality show, serving entertainment and drama—all unfiltered!

metas.name: Crime Patrol Satark
metas.description: Crime Patrol attempts to bring stories of crime happening all around the country. Crimes that tell us that we need to be careful, we need to be watchful. Crimes that tell us lives could have been saved. Every crime we hear of, either warns us to be careful or scares us, it could happen to us. Every crime ignites a feeling, It should not have happened. Would knowing the Why? behind a crime, help in stopping a crime from happening? I don't like the way he looks at me, I don't like the way he/she is behaving, I think he/she is out of his/her mind, I think he/she has gone crazy. That gaze, that quirky smile, that persistent stare which unnerves. It is difficult to understand the intentions but the hints are there. In a house a husband and wife argue, fight. A vessel comes flying, a glass breaks. Husband is angry and the wife is upset. That hatred, that ego. The distance that keeps growing. It is difficult to comprehend the damage, but the cracks are there. Feelings expressions.

metas.name: Indian Idol
metas.description: The Indian version of the Pop Idol format.

metas.name: Kaun Banega Crorepati
metas.description: Hosted by India's biggest superstar, Amitabh Bachchan, one of the biggest shows is here to entertain millions, change lives and make dreams come true.

metas.name: Fear Factor: Khatron Ke Khiladi
metas.description: Twelve celebrity contestants face their worst fears and perform a series of death-defying stunts under the supervision of a host to win the coveted title.

metas.name: Cooku with Comali
metas.description: Cooku with Comali, also known by the acronym CWC, is an Indian Tamil-language comedy-based cooking competition show aired on Star Vijay and streams on Disney+ Hotstar where the contestants are paired each week with comedians (comalis) who are amateur cooks. The first season premiered on 16 November 2019 and ended on 23 February 2020. The second season was premiered on 14 November 2020 and ended on 14 April 2021. The third season was premiered on 22 January 2022 and ended on 24 July 2022. The contestants along with their comalis are challenged every week and judged by Chef Damu and Chef Venkatesh Bhat.

metas.name: MTV Roadies
metas.description: MTV Roadies is a youth-based popular reality television show. It is an Indian version of the original show, Road Rules. In this show, a group of contestants travel to different destinations and participate in various tasks that challenge their physical, social and mental strength.

metas.name: Super Singer Junior
metas.description: Super Singer Junior is a reality TV show since February 2007 hosted by Vijay TV. It is a singing talent hunt for the children of age group 6–15. This is the junior version of the Super Singer show.

metas.name: India's Got Talent
metas.description: This talent show features a huge variety of talent ranging from the mundane to the bizarre from heart-stopping feats to the seemingly impossible giving Indians a platform to showcase their talents like no other.

metas.name: MasterChef India
metas.description: Indian version of the competitive cooking reality series.

metas.name: Kyunki Saas Bhi Kabhi Bahu Thi
metas.description: A mother-in-law's struggle to put up with her three bahu's. The three bahu's have grown up sons. The bahu's sons start to get involved with having girlfriends and the bahu's try and break their relationships up.

metas.name: The Kapil Sharma Show
metas.description: Kapil Sharma is back with his gang - Bindu, Chandan and 'mohalle ki dhoban' Gudiya. In tow is a new character, Maski, along with Goli, Roopmati and more! Enjoy guaranteed laughter with Kapil and his antics as different celebrities join in.

metas.name: Diya Aur Baati Hum
metas.description: Diya Aur Baati Hum is an Indian television soap opera, broadcast on Star Plus channel from 29 August 2011. It stars Deepika Singh and Anas Rashid as the main protagonists.Set on the backdrop of Pushkar, Rajasthan, Diya Aur Baati Hum focused on breaking the stereotypical image of women in rural India by showing the inspirational journey of Sandhya Rathi, whose ambition is to become an IPS officer. She achieves her goal with the help of her husband, Sooraj, by going against all odds

metas.name: Ghum Hai Kisikey Pyaar Meiin
metas.description: Sai Joshi, a fearless girl who aspires to become a doctor, marries an IPS officer, Virat Chavan, pretending to be a deal. The story revolves around the life of Sai in orthodox joint family of Virat and how Sai and Virat fall in love.

metas.name: Kahiin to Hoga
metas.description: Kahiin to Hoga is an Indian soap opera which aired on STAR Plus between September 2003 and February 2007. The show was created by Ekta Kapoor of Balaji Telefilms. The romantic-drama series was show was one of the famous television program during its airing period which helped Star Plus capitalize the television market in the 2004-2006 era. Kahiin to Hoga suffered huge loss when its lead Rajeev Khandelwal left the show in between.

metas.name: Anupamaa
metas.description: Anupama had to sacrifice a lot to become an ideal wife, daughter-in-law, and mother. After a bitter realisation, she sets out to live on her own terms.

metas.name: RadhaKrishn
metas.description: The story of Radha and Krishna is the epitome of eternal love, which transcends eras and emotions.

metas.name: Bade Achhe Lagte Hain
metas.description: Bade Achhe Lagte Hain  is the sublime love story of an unexpected relationship. A marriage of compromise between two completely opposite personalities blossoms into a true partnership.

metas.name: Iss Pyaar Ko Kya Naam Doon?
metas.description: Khushi and Arnav have diametrically opposite ideologies. If Khushi believes in means, Arnav believes only in ends. Khushi's relationships are the most important to her, whereas Arnav believes all people come with a price and can be manipulated for one's benefit.

metas.name: Koffee with Karan
metas.description: Koffee with Karan is an Indian talk show hosted by filmmaker and television personality Karan Johar and produced by Dharmatic Entertainment, the digital content division of Johar's production company Dharma Productions

metas.name: Tulsa King
metas.description: New York mafia capo Dwight "The General" Manfredi is released from prison after 25 years and exiled by his boss to set up shop in Tulsa, Oklahoma. Realizing that his mob family may not have his best interests in mind, Dwight slowly builds a crew.

metas.name: SpongeBob SquarePants
metas.description: Deep down in the Pacific Ocean in the subterranean city of Bikini Bottom lives a square yellow sponge named SpongeBob SquarePants. SpongeBob lives in a pineapple with his pet snail, Gary, loves his job as a fry cook at the Krusty Krab, and has a knack for getting into all kinds of trouble without really trying. When he's not getting on the nerves of his cranky next door neighbor Squidward, SpongeBob can usually be found smack in the middle of all sorts of strange situations with his best buddy, the simple yet lovable starfish, Patrick, or his thrill-seeking surfer-girl squirrel pal, Sandy Cheeks.

metas.name: Doraemon
metas.description: Robotic cat Doraemon is sent back in time from the 22nd century to protect 10-year-old Noby, a lazy and uncoordinated boy who is destined to have a tragic future. Doraemon can create secret gadgets from a pocket on his stomach, but they usually cause more bad than good because of Noby's propensity to misuse them.

metas.name: The Gilded Age
metas.description: It's 1882 and the Gilded Age is in full swing when Marian Brook moves in with her rigidly conventional aunts in New York City. With the help of Peggy Scott, an African-American woman masquerading as her maid, Marian gets caught up in the dazzling lives of her rich neighbors as she struggles to decide between adhering to the rules or forging her own path.

metas.name: The Simpsons
metas.description: Set in Springfield, the average American town, the show focuses on the antics and everyday adventures of the Simpson family; Homer, Marge, Bart, Lisa and Maggie, as well as a virtual cast of thousands. Since the beginning, the series has been a pop culture icon, attracting hundreds of celebrities to guest star. The show has also made name for itself in its fearless satirical take on politics, media and American life in general.

metas.name: Kamen Rider
metas.description: Takeshi Hongo is a promising young man with a passion for motorcycle racing. However, his dreams are suddenly ruined when he gets kidnapped by Shocker, the evil secret organization planning to dominate the world. After being remodeled into a cyborg, Takeshi escapes and swears to protect the world from the inhuman monsters.

metas.name: Chibi Maruko-chan
metas.description: Meet Maruko, a sweet schoolgirl with a hefty dose of curiosity (and occasional laziness!). She sails through life in a cozy town alongside her loving parents, grandparents, and sister. Maruko has a band of loyal friends, including her closest pal, Tama-chan, but her playful and doting grandpa is at the heart of it all. Life is never dull in this charming series.

metas.name: My Little Old Boy
metas.description: How much do you know about your grown up son? In Mom’s Diary, the daily lives of the grown up celebrity sons are closely observed by their mothers. Do you know why your son drinks so much these days? How much do you know about your son’s philosophy in his life style? Heart-warming moments of observational communication between a mother and a son can be seen on Mom’s Diary.

metas.name: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir
metas.description: Marinette and Adrien, two Parisian teenagers, are entrusted with powerful jewels in order to transform into superheroes Ladybug and Cat Noir. But neither hero knows the other's true identity — or that they're classmates!

metas.name: Raw
metas.description: A regularly scheduled, live, year-round program featuring some of the biggest WWE Superstars.

metas.name: NCIS
metas.description: From murder and espionage to terrorism and stolen submarines, a team of special agents investigates any crime that has any connection to Navy and Marine Corps personnel, regardless of rank or position.

metas.name: The Rules
metas.description: Haunted by his past, Metha takes a night shift at a mysterious convenience store where breaking its strange rules leads to supernatural death, forcing him to confront both the store's dark secrets and his own sins.

metas.name: Shetland
metas.description: Created from the novels by award winning crime writer Ann Cleeves, Shetland follows DI Jimmy Perez and his team as they investigate crime within the close knit island community. In this isolated and sometimes inhospitable environment, the team have to rely on a uniquely resourceful style of policing.

metas.name: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit
metas.description: In the criminal justice system, sexually-based offenses are considered especially heinous. In New York City, the dedicated detectives who investigate these vicious felonies are members of an elite squad known as the Special Victims Unit. These are their stories.

metas.name: Law & Order
metas.description: In cases ripped from the headlines, police investigate serious and often deadly crimes, weighing the evidence and questioning the suspects until someone is taken into custody. The district attorney's office then builds a case to convict the perpetrator by proving the person guilty beyond a reasonable doubt. Working together, these expert teams navigate all sides of the complex criminal justice system to make New York a safer place.

metas.name: Saturday Night Live
metas.description: A late-night live television sketch comedy and variety show created by Lorne Michaels. The show's comedy sketches, which parody contemporary culture and politics, are performed by a large and varying cast of repertory and newer cast members. Each episode is hosted by a celebrity guest, who usually delivers an opening monologue and performs in sketches with the cast, and features performances by a musical guest.

metas.name: Detective Conan
metas.description: The son of a world famous mystery writer, Jimmy Kudo, has achieved his own notoriety by assisting the local police as a student detective. He has always been able to solve the most difficult of criminal cases using his wits and power of reason.

metas.name: Scene of the Crime
metas.description: Tatort is a long-running German/Austrian/Swiss crime television series set in various parts of these countries. The show is broadcast on the channels of ARD in Germany, ORF in Austria and SF1 in Switzerland.

metas.name: Chicago Fire
metas.description: An edge-of-your-seat view into the lives of everyday heroes committed to one of America's noblest professions. For the firefighters, rescue squad and paramedics of Chicago Firehouse 51, no occupation is more stressful or dangerous, yet so rewarding and exhilarating. These courageous men and women are among the elite who forge headfirst into danger when everyone else is running the other way and whose actions make the difference between life and death.

metas.name: Chicago P.D.
metas.description: A riveting police drama about the men and women of the Chicago Police Department's District 21 who put it all on the line to serve and protect their community. District 21 is made up of two distinctly different groups: the uniformed cops who patrol the beat and go head-to-head with the city's street crimes and the Intelligence Unit that combats the city's major offenses - organized crime, drug trafficking, high profile murders and beyond.

metas.name: SpongeBob SquarePants
metas.description: Deep down in the Pacific Ocean in the subterranean city of Bikini Bottom lives a square yellow sponge named SpongeBob SquarePants. SpongeBob lives in a pineapple with his pet snail, Gary, loves his job as a fry cook at the Krusty Krab, and has a knack for getting into all kinds of trouble without really trying. When he's not getting on the nerves of his cranky next door neighbor Squidward, SpongeBob can usually be found smack in the middle of all sorts of strange situations with his best buddy, the simple yet lovable starfish, Patrick, or his thrill-seeking surfer-girl squirrel pal, Sandy Cheeks.

metas.name: Dhai Chaal
metas.description: An ambitious politician navigates the treacherous corridors of power, bending rules and forging alliances in a ruthless climb to the top. Morality blurs as survival demands compromise in this dark exploration of political machinations.

metas.name: The Grim Lover
metas.description: Framed for murder following his partner's untimely death, a man finds an unlikely ally in the Grim Reaper, who looks eerily familiar to the man he lost.

metas.name: The Melody of Love
metas.description: Yue Yangyang, a legendary musician in hiding, and Shao Yi, an undercover music spirit, find themselves unlikely allies on a quest to gather sacred music spirits. As they navigate rivalries and uncover secrets, their journey unveils the legendary melodies of the divine score.

metas.name: Pride and Prejudice
metas.description: Elizabeth Bennet is an unmarried woman and the second of five daughters of Mr and Mrs Bennet from Hertfordshire, near London. The Bennet home can only be inherited by males in the family, so the pressure is on for the daughters to marry well or risk losing everything. While out in society, Elizabeth interacts with single men like Mr Darcy, an outwardly, misunderstood curmudgeon.

metas.name: Panchayat
metas.description: Panchayat is a comedy-drama, which captures the journey of an engineering graduate Abhishek, who for lack of a better job option joins as secretary of a panchayat office in a remote village of Uttar Pradesh. Stuck between crazy villagers and a difficult village lifestyle Abhishek starts his job with the sole motivation of getting out of there as soon as possible, for which he even prepares for CAT.

metas.name: All the Love Our Hearts Carry
metas.description: Across three generations and three countries, six couples discover how love, and the wounds it leaves behind, pass from one generation to the next.

metas.name: O Saathi Re
metas.description: Explores love, separation, and shifting emotions as a couple navigates divorce and relationship dynamics.

metas.name: Chaalchitro: The Ekchala Murders
metas.description: The story dives 12 years into the past to uncover the origins of a string of gruesome murders where women were killed and left framed like traditional clay art (ekchala).

metas.name: Sacred Jewel
metas.description: In 1258, with defeat looming after nearly three decades of war against the Mongols, Goryeo's emperor orders the Sacred Jewel of Avalokitesvara retrieved. An elite Yabyeolcho unit leaves Gangdo to find this last hope, crossing ravaged lands and the Baekdu-daegan while evading Mongol forces. Reaching the mainland, they find Goryeo devastated and are soon pursued by the Mongols' deadliest unit.

metas.name: Black Warrant: 'The final verdict'
metas.description: When Judge Bell becomes entangled in a disturbing mystery, an investigation uncovers hidden conspiracies, dangerous secrets, and unexplained events that blur the line between reality and the supernatural.

metas.name: Itihasa: Ramayana Beyond Borders with Shashi Tharoor
metas.description: An exploration of how depictions of the characters of Ramayana – Rama, Hanuman, Ravana and Sita – shape cultures from around the globe.

metas.name: The Murder of JonBenét Ramsey
metas.description: The series centers on one of the most infamous unsolved murder cases in American history, and the devastating personal and public reckoning that followed the death of JonBenet Ramsey on Christmas night in 1996.

metas.name: Tantara
metas.description: In years of crackdowns and fear, Korea's show world kept the lights on and the dream alive — fighting for a stage where grit could turn to glory.

metas.name: Call Me Bae
metas.description: Bae, billionaire fashionista is disowned by her ultra-rich family, owing to a salacious scandal and for the first time in her life, has to fend for herself. On this journey, she overcomes stereotypes and discovers who she really is.

metas.name: Frisco King
metas.description: New Orleans gangster Russell Lee Washington Jr. lands in Frisco, Texas, where he transforms small hustles into big business, with the help of an ambitious protégé, a loyal driver, and a growing network of eccentric partners.

metas.name: Harry Potter
metas.description: There is nothing special about Harry Potter - at least that's what his Aunt Petunia always says. On his 11th birthday, a letter of admittance to Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry opens up a hidden world for Harry: one of fun, friendship and magic. But with this new adventure comes great risk as Harry is forced to face a dangerous enemy from his past.

On his 11th birthday, a letter of admittance to Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry opens up a hidden world for Harry: one of fun, friendship and magic. But with this new adventure comes great risk as Harry is forced to face a dangerous enemy from his past.

metas.name: Neuromancer
metas.description: A disgraced superhacker and a razorgirl assassin are recruited for a high-stakes heist targeting a powerful corporate dynasty with untold wealth...and secrets they'd kill to protect.

metas.name: The Murder of JonBenét Ramsey
metas.description: The series centers on one of the most infamous unsolved murder cases in American history, and the devastating personal and public reckoning that followed the death of JonBenet Ramsey on Christmas night in 1996.

metas.name: ted: the animated series
metas.description: Picking up twelve years after the conclusion of the last movie, John and his thunder-buddy Ted are neighbors, both with families of their own and dead-end jobs. Follow these two lovable stoners as they enable each other's bad ideas about marriage, parenting and the challenges of adult life.

metas.name: Bride of the Barrier Master
metas.description: For thousands of years, Japan has been protected by five clans wielding barrier-weaving magic. Born to a branch family of one such clan, eighteen-year-old Hana has always been stuck in the shadow of her more capable, beautiful, and popular twin sister. When a strong power awakens within Hana, she chooses to hide it so she can continue living a quiet life out of the spotlight. But that ideal lifestyle begins to slip out of reach when Saku Ichinomiya takes over as the new head of the Ichinomiya clan and sets out to find a bride strong enough to stand by his side. Eager to keep her abilities secret, Hana steers clear of Saku... but will she be tempted to sign a marriage contract if it guarantees the peaceful, quiet future of her dreams?

metas.name: Criminal
metas.description: Follow the story of two friends, Leo Patterson and Ricky Lawless, one trying to fight his way out of the world of crime they were raised in, the other desperate to follow in the footsteps of his father, a legendary outlaw. And when Ricky's older brother Tracy returns home from the Army, their tragic family history comes home with him. Drawn into their orbit are Greta, a sharp-tongued car thief from Leo's past, and Mallory, Ricky's girlfriend, who fears what he'll do to get by. Gunfights, heists, and tragic romance are the order of the day, but will anyone make it out alive?

metas.name: Portraits of Delusion
metas.description: In 1935 Gyeongseong, a painter is commissioned to paint a portrait of a captivating woman. As time passes, her true identity and a series of mysterious events are uncovered, and the painter finds himself completely entranced by his subject.

metas.name: Baywatch
metas.description: Following in the footsteps of his legendary father, Hobie Buchannon serves as a Baywatch Captain, leading new generation of lifeguards to the Southern California coast, where high-stakes rescues collide with attraction, friendship, family and responsibility. But Hobie's world is turned upside down when his daughter Charlie Vale shows up on his doorstep eager to carry on the Buchannon family legacy.

metas.name: Quiztopia
metas.description: In an alternate Japan, a charismatic host runs a deadly quiz where winners get any wish and losers pay dearly. His world unravels when rebels target him.

metas.name: The Land
metas.description: The story of two families, in which the high-stakes drama plays out not only on the field but also in the front offices of this NFL franchise, as a loyal fanbase wants a winning season now ... or face big changes if they don't.

metas.name: Bloodaxe
metas.description: Follow Erik Bloodaxe, and his formidable wife, Gunnhild, Mother of Kings as they fight for the throne of Norway, the land is torn apart by fierce rivals, shifting loyalties, and bloody betrayals. With war looming and chaos consuming the kingdom, drawing in the ruthless Kings of other Scandinavian countries, and even a powerful English ruler, the stage is set for a thundering, cataclysmic, compelling and utterly magical new Viking Saga.

metas.name: The Wanted Man
metas.description: For 20 years, Felix Carmichael has been the untouchable leader of Britain's most feared criminal empire. But when a betrayal within his ranks leads to incarceration, Felix will risk everything to exact revenge and reclaim his throne.

metas.name: Garfield
metas.description: Follows Garfield, the lasagna-loving orange cat, along with his owner Jon Arbuckle and Odie the dog, as they navigate daily life and various adventures.

metas.name: Wild Things
metas.description: Magic. Money. Massive tigers. Siegfried & Roy are world-famous entertainers who push illusions to the extreme, as much in their private lives as their Las Vegas shows-until one fateful night unleashes a tragic mystery. Inspired by a true story.

metas.name: Prodigies
metas.description: Didi and Ren have been together since they were nine-year-old geniuses. Now in their early thirties and engaged to be married, they begin to wonder if they've settled for a life—and love—that's less than extraordinary.

metas.name: Bosch: Start of Watch
metas.description: Follow 26-year-old Harry Bosch during his earliest days as a rookie cop in 1991 Los Angeles, a city on the edge, teeming with racial tension, gang violence, and a fractured LAPD. Amid routine calls and growing unrest, Bosch finds himself drawn into a high-profile heist and a web of criminal corruption that will test his loyalty to the badge and shape his future as the detective who lives by the code, "Everybody counts or nobody counts."

metas.name: The Rookie: North
metas.description: After a violent home invasion ignites a dormant purpose, Alex Holland battles a lifetime of failed commitments by joining the Pierce County Police Department as a rookie. Policing from the urban coast to the rural forest where backup isn't just five minutes away, Alex must prove to his skeptical training officer, his fellow rookies and himself that he's finally found something worthy of the fight.
